fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of special strings/null bits in order to potentially bypass AMSI functionalities
fields.name: Potential AMSI Bypass Using NULL Bits
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "if(0){{{0}}}' -f $(0 -as [char]) +" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "#<NULL>"))
